about:
Pro-Tech Power Sales, Inc. is based in Roseville, Minnesota. The company operates as a manufacturers' representative and distributor for power industry equipment across the Upper Midwest and into Canada.

The firm's product portfolio centers on condition monitoring and hardware for electric power transmission and distribution systems. It represents the Doble family of online monitoring products for transformers and bushings, Morgan Schaffer dissolved gas analysis (DGA) products and services, and a range of transmission structures including wood crossarms, braces, hardware, and fiberglass brackets. It also supplies transmission and distribution line hardware along with current and voltage line sensors.

Pro-Tech serves electric utilities, contractors, and engineering firms throughout Colorado, Iowa, Minnesota, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota, Wisconsin, Wyoming, and the Canadian provinces of Manitoba, Ontario, Quebec, and the Maritimes. Its territory coverage reflects a focus on the northern U.S. and central Canadian power markets.

The company emphasizes broad product availability and technical support for the brands it represents, though specific founding details, ownership structure, and certifications are not publicly disclosed.
